title: Design: Over 200 ticked shows its hover text below Deactivate
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have 201 active parts whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all 201.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.9 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Scroll the list down until no more rows load.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  6. Hover over Deactivate on the dark bar.
  7. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first parts are listed.

Step 2:

  • All 201 parts are listed (the list loads 30 at a time).

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • The dark bar shows a round badge with 0.

Step 5:

  • The badge widens to hold 201 and reads 201 selected.
  • The Deactivate button looks dimmed.
  • "201 records selected." shows under the table.

Step 6:

  • A dark grey tooltip reading "Select 200 parts or fewer." appears just below the Deactivate button, over the search box.
  • The tooltip does not cover the badge or the word "selected", which stay readable.

Step 7:

  • The dark bar and the checkboxes disappear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R8a: “One change takes at most 200 parts. With more than 200 rows ticked, the Deactivate button is disabled, and hovering it shows "Select 200 parts or fewer."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate or Activate hovered with more than 200 ticked | "Select 200 parts or fewer." | Tooltip on the disabled button”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
